form_fields.label: Why opta data?
form_fields.value: You serve 60,000+ customers across care, therapy, medical supply and rescue services, with many products and document-heavy billing and approval processes. That is a good place for RAG systems, agents and better developer tooling, and I want to build AI that is measured and trusted, close to home in Essen.

form_fields.label: Salary expectation
form_fields.value: €70,000 gross/year (range €60,000–75,000). Must be above the EU Blue Card threshold.

questions.q: Walk us through a RAG or agent system you built and how you measured its quality.
questions.a: Kniit: LangGraph agents (entity extraction, relationship analysis, consolidation, reflection) on regulatory documents; measured against SAP-derived ground truth; 33/45 → 93/90 precision/recall. Covestro thesis: RAGAS + PytrecEval against chemists' answers; embedding benchmark on 1M+ chunks. Prepare one concrete failure you found through evaluation and how you fixed it.

questions.q: How would you help our developers work more efficiently with GenAI?
questions.a: Start small and measurable: an MCP server that exposes internal knowledge (APIs, coding conventions, product docs) to a coding agent; custom skills for recurring tasks; generated user documentation reviewed by a human; track adoption and time saved. Your evidence: Claude Code with custom skills at Kniit, MCP server built for Claude Code. If the Spec-Driven Coding Agent Harness is built by then, demo it.

questions.q: When is GenAI the wrong tool?" (feasibility analyses)
questions.a: Kniit second data stream: deterministic code beat an LLM, cut a projected $200,000 LLM budget to near zero, accuracy toward 100%. Covestro: advised business stakeholders on where agentic AI fits.
